evidence.claim: The owner requested a flow with a module-type selection interface followed by a module management page and asked which settings belong there.
The owner clarified that this flow belongs to end users after they install AgentOS, not to course learners or course authors.

The owner confirmed that every module has shared chat while exactly one open-set kind selects an additional workbench; document, spreadsheet or accounting, and calendar or scheduling are examples rather than a closed enum.
The owner approved the complete proposed AgentOS post-install module creation and management business model.
